summary: REE Automotive filed a 6-K reporting that Israel's Tel Aviv-Jaffa District Court (Case No. 6493-07-26) issued an October 28, 2026 judgment approving a creditors arrangement under the Israeli Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law (the local analog of a Chapter 11 plan confirmation), following an October 25 creditors meeting. The plan is supported by a $4 million equity commitment — $2 million each from Kukac LLC and Elljay Limited — to fund working capital and continue operations as a private company on a going-concern basis. The court imposed amendments on employee payments and entitlements. Watch funding of commitments and execution risk.
